✓ Green Line E branch.fact: The section between Union Square and Government Center was closed from August 22 to September 18, 2022, to allow for final integration of the Medford Branch, elimination of a speed restriction on the Lechmere Viaduct, and other work. On November 1, 2022, Lechmere became the terminal for E branch service, with trains continuing out-of-service to Medford/Tufts as test trains.
